When a vacation rental host books a cleaner through Turno, they're not just checking a box. They're making a promise to a guest they've never met, arriving at a property they may be managing remotely, that the space will be spotless, welcoming, and ready. That promise lives or dies in the hours between checkout and check-in.

That pressure landed on Chris Rule, VP of Customer Experience, who oversees sales, customer success, support, and operations at Turno. His team of seven CSMs and four activation specialists managed roughly 50,000 active hosts and over 126,000 contractors, with 4,000 to 5,000 new host signups arriving every month.

"Your biggest customers are actually really unhappy with your fees, but they really like your software and support," Chris recalled. "Your smallest customers are really confused about the software. Those insights helped us build out more robust voice-of-the-customer programs and feedback loops back to our product team."

The practical result was immediate: Turno built a contracts and negotiated pricing program for its largest hosts, something the company had never done before. "We would never have had contracts across our biggest customers without that level of NPS and churn data that didn't exist until we got curious with AI," Chris said.

For Turno's hosts, the most meaningful change isn't visible. It's the outreach that arrives at exactly the right moment, from a CSM who already understands their portfolio. Turno is now building the proactive model its mission demands: catching problems before they become churn, identifying opportunity before it becomes someone else's win.

Turno achieved this without adding headcount. The CS team has stayed flat across two years of growth. The leverage came not from more people, but from deploying the right people against the problems that actually matter.

For a team that was always stretched relative to the volume it managed, that's not just an efficiency story. It's a story about what becomes possible when the right host gets reached at the right time, so they can keep making their promise to every guest counting on them.

Turno solves cleaning for the short-term rental industry. Formerly TurnoverBnB, Turno helps vacation rental hosts and property management companies simplify and automate recurring property services like cleaning. STR operators schedule, find, manage, and pay for turnover services – all on one easy-to-use, reliable platform.

With separate mobile apps for hosts and cleaners, Turno syncs guest calendars from all major booking platforms and 20+ channel managers and property management systems. Offering 24/7 live customer support and available in six languages, features include auto scheduling, auto payment, in-app chat, and robust tools to improve efficiencies and ensure quality cleans every time.

Unique in the industry, Turno’s localized, vetted Cleaner Marketplaces include 25K+ STR cleaners across the United States, Canada, Europe, and beyond. Vacation rental operators can invite their current service providers to the platform as well as find and connect with experienced Marketplace cleaners.

Founded in 2016 for short-term rental operators, Turno has grown to be a globally distributed team of over 120 employees across 6 countries. Our team is dedicated to building a product people love, while sustaining a culture that celebrates our people and fosters personal and professional growth.

Turno provides a software platform automating cleaning and turnover services for the short-term rental industry. It allows vacation rental operators to efficiently schedule, manage, and compensate service providers. Dedicated mobile applications integrate with booking channels for automated scheduling, payments, and a robust Cleaner Marketplace.

Assaf Karmon, CEO, and Tim Roy, COO, co-founded Turno in 2016. Their insight aimed to streamline the complex process of managing short-term rental turnovers. By connecting local cleaning professionals with operators and optimizing the workflow, they empower operators to focus on business growth.

The company serves vacation rental hosts, property management firms, and independent cleaning professionals. Turno's mission is to resolve cleaning challenges within the short-term rental sector. It strives to enhance professional standards and global cleanliness for the industry, fostering beneficial partnerships.

Turno rides the explosive growth of short-term rentals, fueled by platforms like Airbnb and post-pandemic travel surges, where operational efficiency is key to scaling amid labor shortages and rising demand.[1][2] Its timing aligns perfectly with STR market maturation—hosts managing 10+ properties need automation to treat rentals as passive income, not manual labor.[2][4]

Turno is poised to dominate STR operations as vacation rentals expand globally, with AI-driven expansions like predictive maintenance and broader service automation (e.g., trash/pool) set to make it indispensable.[2] Trends like rising travel tech investment and labor automation will accelerate its trajectory, potentially pushing toward Series B and international scaling.[1]
